cards.title: Introduction to API Gateway
cards.content:
An API Gateway acts as a single entry point for all client requests to a backend microservices architecture. It handles routing, composition, and cross-cutting concerns like security, rate limiting, and monitoring.

In the Spring ecosystem, Spring Cloud Gateway is the modern, reactive replacement for Zuul, built on top of Spring WebFlux, Project Reactor, and Netty.

cards.title: Core Features of Spring Cloud Gateway

options.text: It is built on blocking Servlet APIs for traditional thread-per-request handling.
It provides non-blocking, reactive routing based on Spring WebFlux.
It directly manages database transactions for all downstream microservices.

cards.title: Configuring Routes in Spring Cloud Gateway
cards.content:
Routes can be defined using Java configuration or YAML. A route consists of an ID, a destination URI, a collection of predicates, and filters.

@Bean
public RouteLocator customRouteLocator(RouteLocatorBuilder builder) {
    return builder.routes()
        .route("user_service_route", r -> r.path("/users/**")
            .uri("lb://user-service"))
        .build();
}

cards.title: Working with Gateway Filters
cards.content:
Filters allow you to modify the incoming HTTP request or the outgoing HTTP response. Spring Cloud Gateway provides many built-in factories like AddRequestHeader, RewritePath, and CircuitBreaker.

spring:
  cloud:
    gateway:
      routes:
        - id: example_route
          uri: https://example.org
          predicates:
            - Path=/example/**
          filters:
            - AddRequestHeader=X-Request-Foo, Bar

items.text: Client sends an HTTP request to the API Gateway.
Gateway Handler Mapping evaluates routing predicates.
Request is forwarded to the downstream microservice.
Gateway post-filters modify the response before returning to the client.

cards.title: Summary & Best Practices
cards.content:
You have learned how Spring Cloud Gateway provides a scalable, reactive entry point for microservices.

  • Always use reactive libraries to prevent blocking the Netty event loop.
  • Combine with Spring Cloud Discovery for dynamic service routing.
  • Implement Resiliency4j circuit breakers for fault tolerance.
